% TS_pb_flips, note below the table. Generated by analysis/paper_assets_isc.py; do not edit.
Success flips of the main study and of Follow-ups 3 and 9, seeds 1 to 5. Top-1 changed: flips whose top-ranked sample index differs. RMSD: the failing side has a ligand RMSD of 2 \AA{} or more and is PoseBusters-valid. Minimum distance: the failing side is below 2 \AA{} and fails one PoseBusters check, the minimum distance to the protein, which requires every ligand-protein distance to be at least 0.75 times the sum of the two van der Waals radii. Excess: how far the failing value lies beyond its threshold, as a percentage of the threshold. Near threshold: every failing criterion exceeds its threshold by at most 10\%. Pose change: the two top-ranked poses lie more than 2 \AA{} apart. The groups pool the flips of a target across contrasts. The 95\% intervals are over targets.
